description: This source file defines data model structures related to chat sessions in an OpenClaw chat UI application, including models for choices, defaults, session entries, and session list responses.

methods.name: init(modelID:name:provider:contextWindow:)

methods.name: init(model:contextTokens:mainSessionKey:)
methods.description: Initializes an OpenClawChatSessionsDefaults instance with optional model, context tokens, and main session key.
